notes.title: Bug Fixes update + vegetation improvements
notes.notes:
Fixed "teleport" bug when cancelling the overhang grappling hook at the wrong moment
 Fixed Arthur Tedjlov character starting at wrong location on Mission 1
 Now damages dealt by smaller enemies won't trigger any reaction. Player will still be able to continue aiming and shooting
 grass vegetation will now interact with players and enemies
 vegetation will now "dissolve" fade when too close to the camera to provide better visibility for aiming and shooting

notes.title: Big Game Update
notes.notes:
Big update! We made quite some changes in the game:


Only one profile can be created instead of 3 in the past
All achievements and leader boards are no longer tied to STEAM but are now global and cross-platform
Added a new, 7th playable Character: Amira Lubya with a special ability of "Electro Homing missiles" (pretty awesome if you ask me!)
Complete remake of Mission 1
Heavily updated Mission 5
More heavy overhaul of the missions will be on their way soon! stay tuned! Thanks again for the critics and feedback of some of our users!

notes.title: Update 1.0.260 // Massive update
notes.notes:
This update brings a ton of fixes and additions:


 Quality settings now works as intended and you can play on lower end devices with the lowest quality settings
 There is now a save file keeping track of the user settings
 Fixed bug In Arena where Some part of the UI wouldn't fade out
 updates to visuals inside M1, 2, 3 and 4 (Volumetric fog)
 Support for a lot of controllers! (Xbox 360 / Xbox One / PS DualShock 2 / PS DualShock 3 / PS DualShock 4 / PS DualSense / Wii U controller / Switch controller pro)
